metadata.description: Agent Skills for Amazon sellers running the TrackIQ MCP.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-daily-snacks-email
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Daily Snacks Email — a three-minute editorial daily email for an Amazon seller account. One lead story with a takeaway, quick bites, a scoreboard, charts, product-line rankings, rank/BSR and a to-do list.

plugins.name: trackiq-amazon-weekly-executive-report
plugins.description: TrackIQ: Amazon Weekly Executive Report — a client-ready week-over-week Amazon recap. Scorecard, pacing against the brand's own trailing four-week average, marginal return by product line, DSP breakout, keyword economics and inventory days-of-cover.
